name: The Data Network
description: The Coordinator's Southeast Asian data brokerage relies on three relay nodes across the region. A typhoon has knocked out the Singapore-to-Manila link. Physical repair is required at the node site.

stages.name: Travel to the Node Site
stages.description: The damaged relay node is located on a small island in the South China Sea. The Coordinator's charts show the typhoon came through approximately three weeks ago.

stages.name: Assess the Damage
stages.description: Inspect the relay hardware. The typhoon may have done physical structural damage, or the surge may have corrupted the firmware. Assess what kind of repair is needed.

stages.name: Repair or Replace the Node
stages.description: Using the Coordinator's repair kit and what you've found locally, restore the Singapore-to-Manila relay link. If the hardware is beyond repair, install the backup unit she provided.
